podcast.body: Alongside the re-edition of his earlier tribute album, Jim James is releasing a new version titled "Tribute To 2" (Trybo 2, numero 2) on December 8th. This new album expands its scope to pay tribute to a wide range of artists, including songs by Elvis Presley and various others like Bob Dylan. "hace la Trybo 2, número 2, en el que ya Rind de tributo a mucha gente al general, desde canciones de Elvis Presley, a mucha gente dispersa Bob Dylan."
